attributes.action: Require offenders convicted of child rape to serve their full custodial sentence
attributes.additional_details: This petition asks the government to change the law so that offenders convicted of the rape of a child are not eligible for automatic or emergency early release. They should instead serve the full custodial sentence imposed by the court before they can be released.
attributes.background: I ask the government to amend the law so that offenders convicted of the rape of a child are not eligible for automatic or emergency release and must serve their full custodial sentence imposed by the court before release.

rejection.details:
It is already the case that such offenders are excluded from early release provisions, whether those that preceded the current Government's early release scheme or those which are part of that scheme.

The Government recently published a full list of such exclusions.
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/sentencing-act-offence-exclusions

Under previous legislation such offenders as you refer to are required to serve their full sentence:
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/sentencing-bill-2023/sentencing-bill-factsheet-serious-sexual-offences-sentencing-and-release-arrangements
